description: This PHP source file defines the class AuthCodeRepository, which implements OAuth2 authorization code repository interface functionalities, such as generating new auth codes, revoking, and checking revocation status. It adheres to the OAuth2 server interface and is part of the SuiteCRM OAuth2 implementation.

classes.name: AuthCodeRepository
classes.description: Implements the OAuth2 AuthCodeRepositoryInterface for managing OAuth2 authorization codes within SuiteCRM, with some methods not yet implemented.

methods.name: persistNewAuthCode
methods.description: Throws NotImplementedException - intended to save a new authorization code.

methods.name: revokeAuthCode
methods.description: Throws NotImplementedException - intended to revoke an existing authorization code.

methods.name: isAuthCodeRevoked
methods.description: Returns true, indicating the auth code is revoked or does not exist.

methods.name: getNewAuthCode
methods.description: Creates and returns a new AuthCodeEntity instance.
